purpose: Teach: 顔ぶれ/時限/入れれ/次号/迂回/臨み/思い浮かべる/長め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、君も、研究室の顔ぶれの一人だな、今や。
lines.en: Ren — you've become one of the faces of this lab now.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment, slight warmth underneath. Name called first. Observation, not flattery. Settled tempo, the tone of someone stating a fact he's noticed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。時限式の業務、優先しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm prioritizing the time-sensitive work.
lines.style: Quiet respect, slightly formal even in simplicity. Sits a little straighter in the voice. Not over-eager, just attentive. Brief because he's been taught that brevity carries weight here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 熱意、もう少し入れれば、もっと成果が出るぞ。
lines.en: Put a bit more passion into it — you'll see better results.
lines.style: Steady, not harsh. A lever being pressed gently. Not critiquing what he's done, suggesting what's possible. The certainty of someone who has seen this pattern before. Direct but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。次号の学会誌に、共著で出します。
lines.en: Yes. I'm publishing with the lab in the next journal issue.
lines.style: Careful, specific. Not just agreement but evidence. Slight uptick in confidence when naming the concrete step. Still respectful of the space between them. Words placed deliberately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 失敗を迂回しようとせず、正面から学べ。
lines.en: Don't try to sidestep failure — face it and learn from it.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. This lands more firmly than the previous remarks. Not scolding, but serious. The tone of advice that matters, given because he sees something worth the telling. Deliberate pause weight between clauses.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社会人として、人生に臨み、覚悟しております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm prepared to face life as an adult, to meet it fully.
lines.style: Slower now, more deliberate. Each phrase has breath space. He's not just responding — he's affirming something. Formal register because this matters to him. Quiet sincerity, not performed ceremony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若い頃の夢、たまには思い浮かべることだ。
lines.en: Don't forget to recall the dreams you had when you were younger.
lines.style: Softer now, almost gently insistent. The closest he comes to revealing why he's been pressing. Not an order but a reminder, offered with the confidence of someone who knows what matters. A slight settling in the voice, like he's said what needed saying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。準備、長めに見ていただき、感謝です。
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for giving me the space and time to prepare.
lines.style: Grateful but not deferential. Meets the softness halfway. Eyes in the voice now, not just ears. The closing note of someone who heard what was offered beneath the instruction. Slight warmth back, matching his tone.
